edges.reason: msg.sender determines and is written into the card registry during enlist.
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender to gate enlist, which is spoofable/phishable.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed as entropy in tmpShuffleSeed, making randomness miner-influenceable.
msg.sender identifies the wagerer and is checked against card ownership.
cardAddress parameter drives all registry lookups and wager writes.
amount parameter is validated and stored as the claim price.
msg.sender is the claimer and recipient of wager payouts.
cardAddress parameter selects the card being claimed.
choices parameter defines the attacking army used in battle math.
cardAddress parameter is forwarded to transferCard.
toAddress parameter is the transfer recipient.
amount parameter is validated against and subtracted from the balance.
withdrawAmount forwards the balance amount to the external sender.transfer call.
withdrawAll forwards the full balance to the external sender.transfer call.
tmpShuffleSeed performs the raw newTmpSeed *= newTmpSeed multiplication lacking overflow checks.
The stored _seed is read and mixed inside tmpShuffleSeed.
_seed is read at enlist start and rewritten with the newly generated seed.
enlist calls shuffleSeed in the constructor-style seed reset path.
enlist calls tmpShuffleSeed to derive random card attributes.
enlist repeatedly calls tmpQuerySeed to roll card type/modifier/stats.
enlist calls cumulativeIndexOf to map rolls onto chance arrays.
wagerCardForAmount calls updateCardStatistics after writing the wager.
cancelWagerOfCard calls updateCardStatistics after clearing the wager.
attemptToClaimCard calls ownerCanClaimCard to validate and get the contender.
attemptToClaimCard calls generateCardsFromClaimForOpponent for the opponent army.
attemptToClaimCard calls calculateAdjustedFiguresForBattle for the stats math.
attemptToClaimCard calls transferCard upon a successful claim.
attemptToClaimCard calls updateCardStatistics after a successful claim.
transferCardTo delegates all transfer logic to transferCard.
shuffleSeed calls tmpShuffleSeed to compute the new _seed.
querySeed calls tmpQuerySeed and persists the result.
tmpQuerySeed re-mixes via tmpShuffleSeed before returning.
ownerCanClaimCard calls getCheapestCardWager to check claimability and price.
updateCardStatistics calls getCheapestCardWager to refresh card stats.
generateCardsFromClaimForOpponent calls tmpQuerySeed to pick opponent cards.
generateCardsFromClaimForOpponent calls tmpShuffleSeed to re-mix the seed.
calculateAdjustedFiguresForBattle resolves cards through registry lookups derived from wager data.
sender.transfer invokes arbitrary fallback on the recipient, which may re-enter withdrawAmount.
sender.transfer invokes arbitrary fallback on the recipient, which may re-enter withdrawAll.
